title: Month 3, Week 1 (Jan 3 – Jan 9, 2027): Reactive Nodes, Small & Aggressive B-Cell, Hodgkin, Flow Cytometry & Blistering Skin (DIF)

days.b1:
Retrieval (15m): Spaced recall of Month 2 Translocation Sarcomas & Salivary Gland fusions.
Reading (75m): SCFHS Curriculum Hematopathology Objectives — Normal Lymph Node Compartments & Reactive Patterns: Follicular Hyperplasia vs. Follicular Lymphoma, Kikuchi-Fujimoto (crescentic MPO+/CD68+ histiocytes, CD123+ plasmacytoid DCs, NO neutrophils) vs. Cat-Scratch (stellate necrotizing microabscesses with neutrophils, Warthin-Starry+), Kimura vs. ALHE, Toxoplasma (Piringer-Kuchinka triad), Castleman (Hyaline-vascular vs. HHV8+ Multicentric), & Rosai-Dorfman (S100+/OCT2+/Cyclin D1+/CD1a- emperipolesis).
days.b2:
Spot Slides (15m): 5 slides @ 3m/case (Kikuchi lymphadenitis, Cat-scratch disease, Hyaline-vascular Castleman, Rosai-Dorfman emperipolesis, Toxoplasma lymphadenitis).
QBank (30m): 15 Reactive Lymph Node & Histiocytosis MCQs.
days.b3: SOE Deliverable: Log 4-Domain SOE entry on Kikuchi-Fujimoto Necrotizing Lymphadenitis vs. Large Cell Lymphoma & SLE.

days.b1:
Retrieval (15m): Blank-sheet recall of Follicular Hyperplasia vs. Follicular Lymphoma.
Reading (75m): WHO Hematolymphoid 5th Ed. — Small B-Cell Neoplasms: CLL/SLL (CD5+, CD23+, LEF1+, CD200+, proliferation centers), Follicular Lymphoma (cFL vs. FLBL; t(14;18) IGH::BCL2, CD10+, BCL6+, BCL2+, Pediatric-type & Duodenal-type FL), Mantle Cell Lymphoma (t(11;14) IGH::CCND1, CD5+, Cyclin D1+, SOX11+, CD23-), Marginal Zone/MALT (t(11;18) BIRC3::MALT1), LPL (MYD88 L265P), & Hairy Cell Leukemia (BRAF V600E, CD11c+, CD25+, CD103+, CD123+, Annexin A1+).
days.b2:
Spot Slides (15m): 5 slides @ 3m/case (CLL/SLL, Follicular lymphoma, Mantle cell lymphoma pink histiocytes, Gastric MALT lymphoepithelial lesions, Hairy cell leukemia fried-egg BM).
QBank (20m): 15 Small B-Cell & Flow Cytometry MCQs.
days.b3: SOE Deliverable: Study One-Pager 1 (Small B-Cell Lymphoma IHC, Flow Cytometry & Molecular Matrix).

days.b1: Retrieval (15m): Draw the Small B-Cell Lymphoma CD5 / CD10 / CD23 / Cyclin D1 / SOX11 / LEF1 / Annexin A1 / MYD88 table from memory.
days.b2:
Slide & Flow Sprint (60m): 6 Lymph Node Spot Slides (3m/case) + 5 Flow Cytometry Scattergram & Lymph Node FNA Cases (Sydney System Cat I–V; kappa/lambda light-chain restriction, CD5+ & CD10+ gating @ 6m/case).
QBank (45m): 20 Flow Cytometry & Lymph Node Cyto MCQs.
days.b3: SOE Deliverable: Log Fresh Lymph Node Excision & FNA Specimen Triage Protocol (RPMI for Flow & Karyotyping, touch preps, snap-frozen, 10% NBF).

days.b1: Secondary System — Vesiculobullous Dermatoses & Direct Immunofluorescence (DIF) (90m): Biopsy rule (H&E from fresh blister edge; DIF from perilesional skin in Michel's medium!); Intraepidermal: Pemphigus Vulgaris (suprabasal tombstones, Desmoglein 3/1, intercellular IgG/C3 fishnet) vs. Pemphigus Foliaceus (subcorneal, Desmoglein 1), Hailey-Hailey (ATP2C1) vs. Darier (ATP2A2); Subepidermal: Bullous Pemphigoid (eosinophils, BP180/230, linear IgG/C3 at roof of salt-split skin) vs. EBA (Type VII collagen, floor of salt-split skin), Dermatitis Herpetiformis (neutrophilic papillary microabscesses, granular IgA), Linear IgA, & PCT (cell-poor, caterpillar bodies).
days.b2: QBank & Slides (30m): 15 Blistering Skin & DIF MCQs + 5 Spot Slides (Pemphigus vulgaris, Bullous pemphigoid, Dermatitis herpetiformis, Hailey-Hailey, Darier).
days.b3: SOE Deliverable: Study One-Pager 4 (Vesiculobullous Diseases, Target Antigens, Salt-Split Skin & DIF Patterns).

days.b1: Retrieval (15m): Recall Pemphigus vs. Pemphigoid vs. Dermatitis Herpetiformis vs. Linear IgA vs. EBA (Blister level, inflammatory cell, DIF pattern, Salt-split skin side).
days.b2:
QBank Sprint (60m): 30 Timed MCQs (15 Heme/Dermpath + 15 2015–2023 Trainee Recalls on Reactive Nodes, Small B-Cell Lymphomas & Blistering Skin).
Deep Review (45m): Dissect recall distractors.
days.b3: SOE Deliverable: Add missed Heme & Blistering Skin recall questions into your 4-Domain SOE Log.

days.b2: (Optional) 30m review of Week 1 Heme & Dermpath SOE entries.
days.b3: Click Push to sync Week 1 of Month 3 to GitHub.

days.b1: Primary System Deep Dive — Aggressive B-Cell & Hodgkin Lymphomas (2.5h): WHO 5th Ed. — DLBCL, NOS (Hans Algorithm: CD10, BCL6, MUM1 -> GCB vs. Non-GCB; Double-Expressor MYC ≥40% + BCL2 ≥50%), High-Grade B-Cell Lymphoma with MYC and BCL2 Rearrangements ('Double-Hit'), Burkitt Lymphoma ('starry-sky', CD10+, BCL6+, BCL2-, Ki-67 ~100%, t(8;14) IGH::MYC), Primary Mediastinal LBCL (CD30+, CD23+, MAL+); Classic Hodgkin (NS, MC, LR, LD; CD30+, CD15+, dim PAX5+, MUM1+, CD45-, CD20-, OCT2-/BOB.1-) vs. NLPHL (LP 'popcorn' cells: CD20+, CD45+, OCT2+, BOB.1+, BCL6+, PD1+ T-cell rosettes, CD30-, CD15-!).
days.b2: Slides & QBank (90m): 12 Heme Spot Slides @ 3m/case (DLBCL, Burkitt, Primary mediastinal LBCL, cHL Nodular Sclerosis & Mixed Cellularity, NLPHL) + 25 Aggressive B-Cell & Hodgkin MCQs.
days.b3: SOE Deliverable (30m): Master One-Pager 2 & record a 3-min spoken SOE response on Large B-Cell Lymphoma Workup (Hans + Double-Hit FISH) and cHL vs. NLPHL vs. THRLBCL.
